title: cop.trace-descriptor/v1
description: Metadata sufficient to reason about a Trace without materializing its raw payload (Issue #61, #63). MUST NOT contain assertion truth or interpretive claims.

kind.description: Classification of the trace occurrence (e.g. procedural_event, artifact_snapshot, external_metering, external_document, git_commit, sensor_log).

origin.description: Durable provenance or origin source of the trace.

observed_at.description: When the trace was observed or registered by the system.

occurred_at.description: Temporal claim of when the trace event physically took place.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp when distinct from occurred_at or observed_at.

custody.description: Source authority reference or custodian maintaining physical or digital custody.
